name: configure_audio_blitter_and_dma
description: The decompiler timed out, so this is described from its hardware use alone: it reads the vertical beam position and sets audio channel 0 pointer, length, period and volume, blitter control, size and modulo registers, the copper pointer, and DMA and interrupt enable registers. It has no recovered caller and runs from outside the static flow.

name: compute_recursive_byte_offset
description: Returns three when the signed byte in D7 minus three is non-negative. Otherwise it recurses while the address register A4 is at most A0, and finally returns three minus the byte in D7.

name: retry_until_nonnegative_result
description: Calls a helper and checks its signed result; while that result is negative it calls the neighbouring routine, copies the returned address outputs, and tries again. It returns the register pair once the helper result is non-negative.

name: return_to_caller
description: Returns immediately without performing any operation on data.

name: add_offsets_on_nonzero_result
description: Calls a helper that returns a 16-bit value and, when that value is non-zero, adds 200000 to one global 32-bit variable and 2 to another. It then returns the register pair unchanged.

name: invoke_structure_callbacks
description: Saves its own address and structure pointer in globals, then calls two function pointers stored in that structure. It finishes with an indirect call through a global address that the decompiler could not resolve.

name: forward_to_unresolved_target
description: Makes a single indirect call through a target the decompiler could not recover, so the routine only forwards control to an unknown address.

name: return_masked_global_value
description: Reads a 32-bit global variable and returns it with bits four to six cleared. It has no other effect.

name: return_top_of_stack
description: Returns the 32-bit value at the top of the stack without changing anything. The interrupt request register listed for this routine does not appear in the recovered code.

name: store_stack_word_to_global
description: Copies the 16-bit value passed on the stack into a global variable and returns. The interrupt request register listed for this routine does not appear in the recovered code.

name: return_zero_constant
description: Returns the constant zero and does nothing else. The listing reports one call, but the recovered code makes none.

name: set_bit_one_in_struct
description: Sets bit one in the byte at offset fourteen of the structure whose pointer is in A1, then returns.

name: return_to_caller

name: store_register_to_global
description: Copies the 32-bit value in data register D0 into a global variable and returns. The listed parallel port register does not appear in the recovered code.

name: copy_global_then_indirect_call
description: Copies a stored global value into another global variable, then makes an indirect call the decompiler could not resolve. The routine is reached through an address loaded relative to the program counter.

name: copy_struct_byte_to_memory
description: Copies the byte at offset six of the structure in A0 into a memory location 2048 bytes above the address held in A6.

name: check_global_constant
description: Returns four when a global 32-bit variable equals a specific constant, and one otherwise.

name: initialize_pointer_chain
description: Writes a sentinel value into a new entry and stores the address of the following entry into three pointer fields across two structures. It also clears a word field in one structure and writes the sentinel into the following entry.

name: copy_nested_pointers
description: Copies a 32-bit value reached through each of two pointers in the source structure into fields of the destination structure, skipping any pointer that is zero.

name: convert_nonzero_to_minus_one
description: Returns minus one, truncated to a 16-bit result, when the value in data register D0 is non-zero, and zero when it is zero.

name: set_bit_six_clear_byte
description: Sets bit six in a byte at offset 3584 from the address register A0, then clears a byte at offset 3072 from the same base. The listed position register is not written by the recovered code.

name: combine_table_values_into_field
description: Combines the first three values of a global table into one number: the first is multiplied by 1440, the second is added, the sum is multiplied by 60, and the third, read as a signed 16-bit value and divided by 50, is added. The result is stored in a 32-bit field at offset 198 of the structure in A2.

name: dispatch_status_by_flags
description: Clears a status byte at offset 31 of the structure in A1, then sets it to 29 when a flag bit in the structure at offset 64 is set. When that flag is clear it calls a handler, sets 28 when a bit in a global mask is zero, or writes an ASCII digit and calls a second handler; it then calls a neighbouring routine and returns the status byte.

name: negate_word_flip_top_bit
description: Negates the 16-bit value at offset 29547 in the structure at A1 and toggles the top bit of the byte at offset 65 in the structure at A3. It returns minus one when that bit was clear before the toggle and zero when it was set.

name: store_inverted_bit_test
description: Tests the bit selected by the byte at offset 67 of the structure at A3 within a global byte, and stores 255 at offset 32 of the structure at A1 when that bit is clear, or 0 when it is set.

name: clear_bit_and_increment_counter
description: Clears the bit selected by the byte at offset 67 of the structure at A3 in a global byte. When that bit was set, it sets flag bit two at offset 64, increments the counter at offset 294, calls the neighbouring routine if the flag was previously clear, clears the flag and increments the counter again.

name: compare_and_dispatch_indirect
description: Compares the A4 register with a saved global value. When they differ it makes an indirect call through a pointer at offset minus twelve from A5, which the decompiler could not resolve. When they match it first calls the neighbouring routine and then makes the same indirect call.

name: store_own_address_in_ram
description: Writes this routine's own address into a fixed RAM location and returns.

name: allocate_and_link_library_nodes
description: Allocates two memory blocks and links them together after opening a library through exec's OldOpenLibrary. It flags the first block, stores pointers to both blocks in globals, and adds the first block to a list with the Enqueue call.

name: invoke_library_function_pointer
description: Calls a library function at offset minus 96 from the library base in A6, then makes an indirect call through the function pointer at offset 22 of the returned structure. The text references dos.library.

name: send_dos_request_and_dispatch
description: Finds the current task, builds a request on the stack tagged with the characters DOS, and sends it through a message port, waiting for the reply. It then searches a table for the matching entry and makes an indirect call to that routine.

name: store_result_then_dispatch
description: Calls helper routines and stores the returned value into a structure, using its low part at offset sixteen when the high part is zero, and stores a second register at offset four. It then performs the same table search and indirect call as its neighbour.

name: store_minus_one_then_dispatch
description: Calls two helper routines, stores minus one at offset twelve and a second register at offset four of a structure, then searches a table and makes an indirect call to the matching routine.

name: store_status_then_dispatch
description: Calls helper routines and, when the first returned high part is non-zero and a check fails, calls a function pointer and stores minus one as the status. Otherwise it stores the returned value, or the code 216 when that high part was non-zero, at offset sixteen with status zero, then performs the table search and indirect call.

name: store_fixed_code_then_dispatch
description: Calls a helper, then stores the code 216 at offset sixteen and zero at offset twelve of a structure, with a second register at offset four. It then performs the same table search and indirect call as its neighbour.

name: copy_buffered_bytes_to_destination
description: Copies up to the requested number of bytes from a 10240-byte buffer in a structure into a destination. It allocates the buffer through a library call when it is missing, and calls a function pointer from a second structure when the copy cannot continue. It stores the number of bytes moved at offset twelve, then performs the table search and indirect call.

name: write_bytes_into_buffered_block
description: Copies the requested number of bytes from a source into a 10240-byte buffer in a structure. It allocates the buffer through a library call when it is missing and calls a flush function pointer when the buffer fills. It stores the request length at offset twelve, then performs the table search and indirect call.

name: flush_then_store_and_dispatch
description: Calls a flush function pointer from a second structure, stores the requested length at offset twelve and a second register at offset four, then performs the same table search and indirect call as its neighbour.

name: store_status_with_optional_field
description: Calls helper routines and stores either the returned value at offset sixteen with status zero, or a value at offset thirty-six of a second structure with status minus one. It then performs the table search and indirect call of its neighbour.

name: store_status_with_optional_field

name: retry_helper_after_library_call

name: flush_if_buffered_then_dispatch
description: Calls a function pointer from a second structure when a counter at offset 256 of a buffer structure is non-zero, then stores minus one at offset twelve and a second register at offset four. It then performs the table search and indirect call.

name: compute_bounded_position_offset
description: Computes a new position from an offset and a mode held in the structure. When the result passes the stored limit it stores minus one with the code 219, otherwise it stores the previous position and keeps the new one, then performs the table search and indirect call.

name: advance_position_with_bounds_check
description: Adds a value to a position in the structure in A0 and, when the result passes the stored limit, stores minus one with the code 219 instead. Otherwise it stores the previous position, then performs the table search and indirect call.

name: store_fixed_error_then_dispatch
description: Stores the code 219 at offset sixteen and minus one at offset twelve of a structure, with a second register at offset four. It then performs the table search and indirect call of its neighbour.

name: copy_table_field_into_entry
description: Stores a table entry pointer into a slot chosen by a loop index, then copies a field from a second table into the entry at offset 32. The loop continues until its index passes sixteen.

name: link_table_entry_to_slot
description: Copies a table entry selected by a loop index into a fixed structure slot, then stores a pointer to a second structure field at offset 40 of that entry. The loop then continues.

name: store_table_value_by_index
description: Stores a table entry into a slot chosen by an index held in the structure, then makes two library calls and two neighbouring routine calls.

name: call_helper_per_table_entry
description: Calls a neighbouring routine, then calls a helper with each of the seventeen table entries in turn and returns.

name: finish_entry_or_clear_state
description: Calls a helper with its argument and, when that succeeds, calls it again for entries whose state at offset 32 is five. Otherwise it calls a library function and clears the word at offset 24.

name: clear_entry_link_fields
description: Loops over seventeen table entries and, for each non-null entry whose state at offset 32 is not five, clears a 32-bit field reached through its pointer chain.

name: accumulate_positive_entry_states
description: Loops over seventeen table entries, adding the positive state values at offset 32 into four local counters, and calls two neighbouring routines.

name: set_entry_word_and_call
description: Stores a table word into offset 22 of an entry selected by a loop index, then calls a helper with that entry and a value from a second table.

name: call_helper_with_entry_constants
description: Calls a helper with a table entry, a value from a second table, the constant 120 and zeros, then reads the entry's first field and calls a neighbouring routine.

name: dispatch_entry_state_loop
description: Runs a loop that switches on an index, storing a table word into an entry and calling a helper in one case, and repeats until the index changes.

name: call_helper_for_indexed_entry
description: Calls a helper with a table entry, two values from a third table and a computed index, then increments a loop index held in the structure.

name: dispatch_entry_state_loop
description: Runs a loop that switches on an index, storing a table word into an entry and calling a helper in one case, and repeats until the index changes.

name: call_helper_with_optional_library
description: When a word field at offset 156 is non-zero, calls a helper with a table entry and a value from a second table, then makes a library call and calls further neighbouring routines.

name: store_library_result_in_field
description: Calls a helper with a structure offset and stores the result of a library call in a 32-bit field. It then makes conditional follow-up calls depending on other fields.

name: run_counted_library_loop
description: Makes three library calls, then loops for the count stored at offset 1260 of the structure, calling further routines on each pass.

name: call_four_library_functions
description: Calls four library functions in turn, reads a field through a pointer chain, then calls two neighbouring routines with that data.

name: store_library_result_or_default
description: Calls a library function and stores its result in a field. When the stored value is zero it takes a fallback path that calls a neighbouring routine.

name: call_helper_in_three_passes
description: Calls a helper with a fixed set of offsets on each of three passes, passing its argument as the first value.

name: fill_buffer_from_indexed_pointer
description: Looks up a pointer from a table by index and writes bytes through it into a buffer, using three loop values, then calls a neighbouring routine.

name: run_library_pair_loop
description: Loops twice, making several library calls on each pass, and calls a neighbouring routine at the end.

name: decrement_field_and_test_bit
description: Decrements a counter at offset 36 of a structure, passes the lowest bit of the new value to a helper, then calls two further routines and returns a flag from the result.

name: compare_linked_fields_then_call
description: Checks a 16-bit field of one linked structure against a field of another, and calls up to six neighbouring routines depending on the comparison.

name: adjust_linked_field_and_call
description: Calls a helper, adjusts a 16-bit field of a linked structure by seven when the result allows it, and calls up to eight neighbouring routines.

name: reset_countdown_and_call
description: When a counter in the structure is below one, calls two neighbouring routines with fixed arguments and resets the counter to seven.

name: reset_countdown_and_call
description: Calls two neighbouring routines with fixed arguments, then sets the counter in the structure to seven.

name: write_five_decimal_digits
description: Writes a number into a buffer as decimal digits, counting down from 10000 and emitting one ASCII character per step through a helper, then calls two neighbouring routines.

name: call_two_helpers_with_buffer
description: Calls a helper with the first field of a structure and a buffer pointer, then calls a second helper with fixed values including 64 and 20.

name: select_masked_index_and_call
description: When a structure field equals minus one, takes a value from a helper, masks it to its low four bits, passes it to another helper, and calls a library function.

name: initialize_structure_defaults
description: Sets several fields of the structure to default values, copying 16-bit values from fixed offsets of the same structure into others.
